en.lang_help: Choose your preferred language for messages and bot interface. If automatic detection is enabled, we will always use your Telegram account language.
en.await_args_help: If a command requires arguments, the bot will wait for you to provide them before continuing.
en.response_help: Control how the bot responds and displays messages. Indicators will only be shown when the bot’s response will take considerable time.
en.datetime_help: Set your time zone so that timestamps in messages are correct. If none is selected, GMT will be used by default or automatically detected time zone.
en.privacy_help: Manage how your data is handled during interactions with the bot.
en.notifications_help: Control which notifications you receive from the bot.
en.interface_help: Adjust how the bot interface looks and feels in the mini app.
